English (en): Open a wallet to run a P2P round.
Hausa (Nigeria) (ha-NG): Buɗe wallet don gudanar da zagayen P2P.

English (en): Steps 1–4 run end-to-end on the server path: the wallet joins a pool, exchanges blind signatures, submits over Tor, and broadcasts the assembled CoinJoin. Wasu abubuwan ƙarfafa wallet na gwaji har yanzu ana jira, amma ana tabbatar da fitarwarka kafin sa hannu, don haka zagaye mara inganci yana ƙare lafiya.

Hausa (Nigeria) (ha-NG): Dukkan masu shiga suna watsa cinikin da aka gina tare.

Hausa (Nigeria) (ha-NG): CashFusion yana haɗa UTXO na masu shiga da yawa zuwa ciniki guda, yana karya alaƙar tarihin blockchain tsakanin shigarwa da fitarwa. Ba ya riƙe kuɗinka — kuɗinka suna ƙarƙashin ikonka koyaushe.
